headline: Consumer Protection Commission reviews pre-sale home contracts: 11 projects violated, total fines NT$3.54 million | Politics
summary: The Executive Yuan reviewed standard-form contracts for 69 pre-sale projects and found 11 in violation, with fines totaling NT$3.54 million. The non-compliance rate was lower than in previous years.
why: Pre-sale home contracts govern how developers take buyer deposits, so enforcement affects developer risk and the housing market.
